definitions.explanation: An amount left over beyond what is needed or used: surplus stock, staff, funds or power. Used mainly in economics, business and policy contexts.

examples.japanese: {余剰|よじょう}⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余剰|よじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: There was a rice surplus this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽光|たいようこう}{発電|はつでん}→太陽光発電：07831_taiyoukouhatsuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余剰|よじょう}{電力|でんりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電力|でんりょく}→電力：14609_denryoku⟧{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦ことができる→ことができる：32887_kotogadekiru⟧。
examples.english: Surplus power from solar panels can be sold to the power company.

notes:
Mostly appears in compounds; in everyday speech ⟦{余|あま}り→余り：17255_amari⟧ or ⟦{余分|よぶん}→余分：03667_yobun⟧ is usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余剰|よじょう}⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧: surplus staff
- {余剰|よじょう}⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧: excess inventory
- {余剰|よじょう}⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧: surplus funds
- {余剰|よじょう}{電力|でんりょく}: surplus electricity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{余分|よぶん}→余分：03667_yobun⟧: extra, spare — everyday word
- ⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧: excessive — stresses that there is too much, a problem
